data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘arz (ar-za-ma), meaning ‘exalted’, ‘noble’, and ‘elevated’. A name that signifies status, honor, and respect in Islamic tradition. The name Aarzam carries the meaning “Exalted, noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aarzam usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
